notes: Java discovery (line 298-314) first tries the slot's own recorded worldLevelName as a direct subfolder (line 299-301); only if that's absent/non-empty-but-missing does it fall back to scanning unzipDir's immediate children, filtering out anything ending _nether/_the_end and anything starting __ or . (line 304-310), sorting the survivors lexicographically, and taking the first (line 311-312, `.sorted { $0.lastPathComponent < $1.lastPathComponent }`). Two folders that both look like valid overworld folders (e.g. a zip with more than one top-level non-dimension directory, which should not normally happen but isn't guarded against) would silently pick whichever sorts first -- worth flagging as a real ambiguity the Rust port inherits rather than resolves.
